tags: tier is the engine's code and verification state today, not a build judgement; it is meant to be GENERATED from Proving Ground results (ADR 0020), until then it is typed from the profiles and live notes. reqLevel/reqSkills: V for Sorceress (docs/research/sorc-skill-matrix.md, read from skills.txt), S for Paladin (SME read, leveler/palprobe_test.go). synergies: null = not known (never 'none'); [] = none; the runtime overlay (Caps.Overlay) replaces req and synergies by skills.txt when the tables are loaded. mana.source names where the cost per level comes from: skilldamage.json (V, game.exe functions run in the emulator) or the skills.txt columns. Necromancer (necro1, 2026-11-20): reqLevel and reqSkills of all 30 rows are V, read from the patched skills.txt of the worker host (charclass nec); synergies of damage rows are its DmgSymPerCalc/EDmgSymPerCalc, of summon rows the skill() references in its calc columns; skill names are the skills.txt names (BloodGolem, IronGolem, FireGolem). Tiers are read from internal/combat necro.go, necro_corpse.go and profiles.json (docs/process/necromancer-support.md). Barbarian (barb1, 2026-11-20): reqLevel and reqSkills of all 30 rows are V, read from the patched skills.txt of the worker host (charclass bar); synergies of damage rows are its DmgSymPerCalc (only War Cry has one), of buff rows the skill() references in their aura-length calc; Iron Skin is a passive in skills.txt (row corrected from buff). Tiers are read from internal/combat and profiles.json (docs/process/barbarian-support.md). Druid (druid1, 2026-11-20): reqLevel and reqSkills of all 30 rows are V, read from the patched skills.txt of the worker host (charclass dru); synergies of damage rows are its EDmgSymPerCalc and DmgSymPerCalc, of summon rows the skill() references in their calc columns; Wearwolf, Wearbear and Shape Shifting are Werewolf, Werebear and Lycanthropy in game; Fissure is Eruption. Tiers are read from internal/combat (druid.go, classdata/skills.json and profiles.json) and docs/process/druid-support.md; no row is supported because no Druid skill ever ran live.
